_doc: #797 THE list of Phosphor icons Cloud Search draws (the owner's mockup uses Phosphor). phosphor2vd.py fetches each SVG of `version` from the npm package @phosphor-icons/core (MIT, see NOTICE.md) and writes it as res/drawable/ph_<name with - as _>.xml; test/test-search-shell.sh S9 holds this list, the drawables on disk and every R.drawable.ph_* the Kotlin names to one another. To add an icon: add it here and run `python3 app/tools/phosphor2vd.py`.
